mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when the federal funds rate increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when real GDP declines for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within a month signals a strong supply-side response, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when industrial production increases by more than 2% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening consumer demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending boosts corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when retail sales increase and the unemployment rate decreases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: An inversion of the yield curve, indicated by a higher 10-year Treasury yield than the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS), signals an impending economic slowdown, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when the yield curve inverts.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending improve.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when nonfarm payrolls increase for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% within a month signals a weakening demand for new homes, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates a broader economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when housing starts decline by more than 10% within a month.
